sloka: नहि वेदितवान्मन्ये हनूमानात्मनो बलम् ।यद्दृष्टवाञ्जीवितेष्टं क्लिश्यन्तं वानराधिपम् ।। ७.३५.१२ ॥
transliteration: nahi veditavānmanye hanūmānātmano balam ।yaddṛṣṭavāñjīviteṣṭaṁ kliśyantaṁ vānarādhipam ।। 7.35.12 ॥

translations.english: I believe Hanuman did not know his own strength, because he saw Sugriva, who was dear to him as life, suffering.
